source.document: 2025 Fujian provincial robot competition tentative rules
source.width_derivation: The right blue shooting square is treated as the 800 mm square specified for shooting areas, and the vertical automatic passage is bounded by its collinear left/right edges. The horizontal leg is modeled at the same 800 mm width as a provisional corridor-continuity assumption, not as a separately labeled dimension.
source.fixed_wall_uncertainty: The diagram is a plan view and does not fully specify which course borders are physical walls. Boundary walls in this model are virtual training restrictions.
